name: Samophlange Manual
label: Quest
description: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob needs help with a broken samophlange. The goblin engineer sends you back into the Barrens for the operating instructions…

clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob needs help with a broken samophlange. The goblin engineer sends you back into the Barrens for the operating instructions, held by his former Venture Company rival.

Rilli Greasygob once worked beside Boss Copperplug in the Venture Company. Copperplug oversaw the samophlange’s inner workings and guarded their secrets closely. He shared no manual with Rilli. Instead, he gave out separate pages only to underlings he trusted, leaving his fellow engineer without the knowledge to understand the device.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first. When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted. I wasn't one of the trusted few...
Boss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens. Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got the manual! I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange! I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet—he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.
I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
